newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Reef Casino gets cash injection.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Reef Casino gets cash injection.

text.p: Reef Casino Trust said on Tuesday it would get a cash injection of A$6 million in two instalments from its lessee Casinos Austria International Ltd.
Casinos Austria's will pre-pay its annual base rent obligations for the 12 years from July 1, 1998.
In return, Reef Casino had agreed to forego the indexation of the base rent which would have occurred had the rent been paid in the ordinary course.

Reef Casino said Casinos Austria would pay $3 million to the Trust as soon as we have the relevant approvals for this arrangement, while the second instalment of $3 million would be paid on January 2, 1997.
"While this arrangement was therefore conditional at this stage, the board is confident that the final approvals will be obtained and that the funds will be injected as described," Reef Casino said.
The board was confident that the initiative would assist the Reef Hotel Casino into the future in both a financial and operational way.
"In the meantime, the Board is actively considering all options available to enhance the interests of the unitholders in the trust," Reef Casino said.
Trade in Reef Casino Trust shares was halted on Monday after the company announced late on Friday it had made a surprise loss of A$5.9 million in the three months to September 30.
